notes.subject: fix(mcp): refresh remembered capabilities on 2026-07-28 connections
notes.summary: MCP connections that reuse a remembered 2026-07-28 protocol verdict now refresh the server's capabilities once and reconnect if they changed, so servers updated in place are noticed immediately instead of after 7 days.
